title: Slow growth
description: Makes crops grow 10x slower (it takes 10-15 (in game) days to grow a wheat)
body:
This mod slows down crop growth by a factor of ten, making farming in Minecraft feel more challenging and realistic. Instead of crops instantly reaching maturity, players must plan ahead and manage their farms carefully. By requiring more patience and strategy, the mod creates a balanced gameplay experience where agriculture feels more immersive, rewarding, and true to life compared to the vanilla game.

(works on trees too + fully customizable, commands - /slowgrowth [number] )
